messages:
Mira Chen: Heads-up — found a dead link in the runtime guide on staging: https://docs.redwood/inference/runtime#cache-config -> 404. Anyone owns the runtime guide?
Sam Patel: Thanks, Mira. Is that the staging preview or the published site?
Mira Chen: Staging preview (staging.docs.redwood). I clicked the anchor in the caching section after the recent TOC refactor.
Olivia (docs-bot): Automated link scan flagged this at 2024-09-02T09:12Z and created issue #4123. Assigned to @Alex Gomez but still open.
Alex Gomez: That's me — I'm out until EOD but can patch the anchor tonight. Is there a canonical slug we should point to instead of the anchor?
Mira Chen: No shortlink for that section yet. Quick fix would be to update the anchor to "cache-and-kv" and add a brief redirect note in the runbook.
Alex Gomez: OK will open a tiny PR (sed replace + add fragment) in ~30m. Please ping @Sam Patel for a quick CR when it's up — should be a one-liner.
Sam Patel: Can review after standup, ping me then :thumbsup:
Linh Tran: FWIW if this keeps happening we should add a shortlink entry so anchors aren't fragile across refactors. Maybe add to the docs checklist for TOC changes.
Mira Chen: Good call. I added a comment in #4123 recommending shortlink and a tiny checklist item. Linking the issue: https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/4123
Alex Gomez: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5520 — sed change + shortlink entry added. Requesting review from @Sam Patel.
Sam Patel: Reviewing now, looks trivial. Approving in a minute.
Olivia (docs-bot): Staging redeploy scheduled after PR merge.
Mira Chen: Thanks all — marking resolved once staging shows the fix. :white_check_mark:
